{{Quote|Been in this dump for weeks trying to wrangle these guys. Doctor Zeke's made a name for himself on the black market selling premium cybernetics. Couldn't risk calling it in unless I caught the jerks red-handed.|Lylos Tannon, Coruscant Security Force|<ref name="OneNight">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150213|text="One Night in the Dealer's Den"|int=One Night in the Dealer's Den}}</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Zeke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the period of the [[Galactic War]]. Together with his associate, [[Bolgm]], Doctor Zeke worked a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] scam where he would remove them from individuals and then sell the cybernetics on the black market. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|defeat]] of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], Doctor Zeke was called by Bolgm to come retrieve the cybernetics from an individual he had secured at the [[Dealer's Den]] cantina. The individual turned out to be [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] who was working an undercover sting with [[Lylos Tannon]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Tannon had been tracking Doctor Zeke for several weeks and had enlisted Shan and SIS Agent [[Jonas Balkar]] to help her. Doctor Zeke, realizing he had been found out, tried to flee but was tackled by Shan and then arrested by Tannon.
